source: Figma plugin API (use_figma, read-only), 2026-10-22. Pult frames 04/05/12 (phone) and 04/12 (tablet) are dumped in full; the other screens are frame shells (name and bounds only). Vectors and shapes are dropped; icon, status bar, home indicator, page dots and pult header instances are kept without children.

nodes.name: Phone — lobby controller (primary for permanent installations)

annotations.text:
**/wall/mode** `"ambient" | "react" | "show"` · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Single-select: exactly one mode is lit. Icons map 1:1 to the option values.

**/wall/logo**, **/wall/live-data**, **/wall/audio-react** → `1 | 0` · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Each row is an independent toggle. *Audio react* needs the installation’s audio input; without it the row is hidden.

**/wall/brightness** `float 0–1` · absolute · 60 Hz · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Double-tap resets to default 0.6. Hidden while Blackout is on.

**/wall/hue-drift** `float 0–1` · relative (drag moves by distance) · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Value comes back from the installation; the pult never jumps to the finger.

**/prompt/text** `string` (live prompt) · applied ✓ when the installation echoes it or sends **/prompt/text/applied**
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Presets live in the bridge (not the config): create, edit, reorder, soft delete with Undo. Applying → Error after 4 s without confirmation. Lease holder or studio only.

nodes.name: Tablet — live-event VJ console (primary for live events)

annotations.text:
**/mix/layer/{1–4}/opacity** `float 0–1` · **/mix/layer/{1–4}/on** `1 | 0` · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Strip off → fader dims and stops sending; the value is kept and resent when switched back on.

**/fx/shape/{knob-id}** `float 0–1` · 240° knobs · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Knob ids = layer names in Figma (Inspector). Hue knob sends degrees 0–360.

**/layers/{name}** `1 | 0` · multi-select · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Any number of layers can be on; LED strip shows the live state from feedback.

**/camera/aim** `x y float −1…1` · springs back · 30 Hz
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Only while the installation runs the camera scene; otherwise the panel shows Unsupported.

**/scene** `int 1–4` + crossfade `float s` · feedback ✓
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Scene list comes from the config; renaming a scene in Figma renames it for the client.

**/prompt/text** `string` (live prompt) · applied ✓ when the installation echoes it or sends **/prompt/text/applied**
*draft — confirm against the installation’s `otakoyi/osc-contract.json`*
Presets live in the bridge (not the config): create, edit, reorder, soft delete with Undo. Applying → Error after 4 s without confirmation. Lease holder or studio only.
